description:
Blessings is a former famous certified yoga instructor who went to India to get her training at the source. She worked for all kinds of high-end yoga studios, such as Yoga Works, Equinox, Bay Club, Club Sport, the Studio, etc. When she looked into what she was actually practicing, she was shocked to discover how dark the religion of yoga actually gets.
